inclusion_rule: Include studies that synthesize speech or acoustic features from ultrasound tongue images (with or without lip video) and evaluate the output; classify the output measures used (MCD or other spectral distance, MUSHRA or MOS ratings, listener transcription or identification, ASR on the synthesized speech). Boundary: exclude recognition-only studies, contour tracking and reviews (they inflate the pattern match, an upper bound); count versions once by key.

sota_candidates.metric: MUSHRA naturalness range for adapted systems (~20 sentences)
